tweet_pool.author: deepseek_ai
tweet_pool.text: We're launching DeepSeek-V4-Pro today! Major Agent upgrades with strong production gains! Flexible reasoning effort for V4-Pro & V4-Flash: low for simple tasks, high for daily Agent workflows, max for complex tasks. Native OpenAI Responses API support.

tweet_pool.author: demishassabis
tweet_pool.text: Gemini 3.7 Flash brings major upgrades for software engineering, web dev & knowledge work. And introductory price is half the original 3.6 Flash cost.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Google model release with pricing detail.

tweet_pool.author: kimmonismus
tweet_pool.text: Before stepping down as DeepMind CEO, Demis Hassabis reportedly pitched an independent body to set safety standards for advanced AI. The WSJ says he discussed the plan with other AI-lab leaders and Trump officials, including Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Policy/company move sourced to WSJ reporting.

tweet_pool.author: moo9000
tweet_pool.text: Mistral, the only company in the EU who managed to build a general purpose LLMs, gives up and announces they will host Chinese LLM models instead. Earlier Mistral announced they will focus on a smaller model, Shieldtral, geared towards online censorship.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: European frontier-lab strategy shift.

tweet_pool.author: bcherny
tweet_pool.text: A weird experiment I've been trying the last few weeks is having Claude take over day-to-day maintenance of our apps. The setup is straightforward: we have a Slack channel called proj-claude-maintains-apps.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete practitioner report from the Claude Code creator.

tweet_pool.author: random_walker
tweet_pool.text: Prediction: we will soon enter an era where the latency of agentic work is bottlenecked not by LLM inference speed but by tool use. Shell commands, build pipelines, computer use, web data extraction.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Technical analysis of agent performance limits.

tweet_pool.author: hakimieiqbal
tweet_pool.text: Claude Opus 5 spent 24 hours trying to build GTA 6 on its own. After the initial prompt, the agent was left to make the decisions itself, including the city, districts, roads, buildings, cars, NPCs, and weather.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Long-horizon autonomous agent experiment.

tweet_pool.author: keachhagey
tweet_pool.text: The internet has been so scrubbed of references to Dario Amodei's wife, Cami Clark, that if you Google her, you get a picture of his sister instead. But she has been an influential force in his career, introducing him to Eric Schmidt.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: WSJ reporting on Anthropic leadership.

tweet_pool.author: alexocheema
tweet_pool.text: 20,000 Hugging Face accounts connected to local.ai in the last 24 hours. The open-source AI community is showing up.
